operations.old:

terrestrial devices operate without GNSS capabilities and do not
pre-compensate for delay and Doppler shifts \cite{shen2025}.

operations.old:
The high mobility of the LEO satellite and multipath propagation
give rise to doubly dispersive terrestrial-satellite links (TSLs)
\cite{shen2025}.
operations.new:
The terrestrial-satellite links (TSLs) will experience fast variations
due to the high mobility of the LEO satellite. Hence, this time variation
and multipath propagation require a doubly dispersive channel model
for accurate TSLs characterization \cite{shen2025}.

source_refs.quote: The TSLs will experience fast variations due to the high mobility of the LEO satellite. Hence, this time variation and multipath propagation require a doubly dispersive channel model for accurate TSLs characterization.

operations.change_reason: 恢复 Shen 连续两句的高速引起时变、时变和多径要求双扩展模型的因果关系；仅首次将 TSLs 展开。不新增物理假设。
necessary_substitutions: TSLs 首次出现展开为 terrestrial-satellite links (TSLs)。

operations.old:
The differential delay
of this path is $\tau_{k\ell}=\widetilde\tau_{k\ell}-\tau_c$, where
$\widetilde\tau_{k\ell}$ denotes its propagation delay.
operations.new:
$\tau_{k\ell}=\widetilde\tau_{k\ell}-\tau_c$ represents the differential
delay for the $\ell$th path from device $k$ to the satellite, where
$\widetilde\tau_{k\ell}$ and $\tau_c$ are denoted as propagation delay
and common delay, respectively.

source_refs.quote: As shown in Fig. 1, τ_{i,u} = τ̃_{i,u} − τ^c represents the differential delay for the i-th path from the u-th device to the satellite, where τ̃_{i,u} and τ^c are denoted as propagation delay and common delay, respectively.
source_refs.note: 英文逐字核对；引语中的数学符号是原 PDF 的文本转写，原文共同延迟 c 为上标，本稿 τ_c 将其改为下标。
